qualification.details: Must fulfil Panjab University PhD admission norms. Must be a fresh applicant for PhD admission in UIET (CSE/IT/ECE) for the Academic Year 2026-27. Must secure written consent from a UIET faculty supervisor.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Panjab University PhD Fellowship Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Panjab University to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Panjab University PhD Fellowship Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Panjab University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University PhD Fellowship?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Panjab University PhD Fellowship is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the PhD Fellowship?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the PhD Fellowship post at Panjab University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the PhD Fellowship?
faq.answer: The fellowship offers a salary of Rs. 46,250 per month for the first and second year, and Rs. 52,500 per month for the third to fifth year.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the PhD Fellowship?
faq.answer: Candidates must fulfill Panjab University PhD admission norms, be a fresh applicant for PhD admission in UIET (CSE/IT/ECE) for the Academic Year 2026-27, and secure written consent from a UIET faculty supervisor.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the PhD Fellowship?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Application Review and securing Consent from a Supervisor.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website for Panjab University?
faq.answer: The official website for Panjab University is https://uiet.puchd.ac.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this PhD Fellowship recruitment is 3522/UIET.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this fellowship?
faq.answer: The application mode for this PhD Fellowship is Online.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this fellowship?
faq.answer: The job type for this PhD Fellowship is Full Time.
